ownership.quote: OmniRun is built and operated by A14A B.V. Sandboxes run in Hetzner data centers in Germany, and all data stays in the EU.

stage.quote: A14A is a venture builder that partners with corporations to create new companies. We handle the full stack: from idea validation through launch and scale. ... OmniRun Cloud sandbox platform providing isolated Firecracker microVMs for safely running AI agent code with sub-second boot times.
stage.note: No external funding round, investor, or accelerator mention found for OmniRun or its parent A14A B.V. anywhere (company pages, GitHub org, HN Algolia search). OmniRun is one of roughly 20 in-house products built by A14A, a small Amsterdam-based venture builder/studio (GitHub org founded 2020, 2 followers), consistent with an internally-funded, bootstrapped studio project rather than a VC-backed standalone startup. No press coverage or Crunchbase/PitchBook profile was found for OmniRun or A14A within the search time budget, so this is an inference from the absence of any funding signal plus the venture-builder structure, not a direct company statement about financing.

note: OmniRun is not an independent startup: it is one of ~20 concurrent in-house products built by A14A B.V., a small Amsterdam venture-builder/studio (other products include DataGigant, ScalarOps, OmniClaw, Claude Skill Manager, DNSFlat, LedgerSoft, etc.), operated on Hetzner infrastructure in the EU. No funding, accelerator, or revenue information is public for OmniRun or A14A. Buyers should weigh this as a small-team, studio-run product rather than a funded, dedicated infrastructure company.
